hypothesis: A semantic proposer can expand coverage of cross-event ordered predicates that the within-event structural scanner does not group, while a separate deterministic verifier prevents language-model confidence from becoming payoff proof.

inputs.optional_model_role: supply two existing rule hashes and a proposed relation type only

hard_boundaries.economic_scoring: performed only later by the existing synchronized depth/fee/orphan scanner

evaluation.independent_unit: one proposed relationship before deterministic review
evaluation.null_outcome: Cross-event semantic proposals may add no correctly certifiable relationships beyond the existing within-event graph.
